usedFor: QuickBooks is where invoices and bills get created; Slack is where your team hears about them. A “New Invoice” in QuickBooks can post through “Send Message” to a channel, or ping one person with “Send Direct Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in QuickBooks, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: One channel post puts every new invoice in front of the whole finance or sales team, and “Send Message” can target a channel name or ID.

watchOut: “New Invoice” and “New Bill” in QuickBooks are polling, so the Slack post lands after the next check. An automation's post to a Slack channel also waits for your approval today.
